description: This source file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Snow Device Management service. It extends the AwsClient class and includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, describing, listing, tagging, and untagging devices and tasks related to Snow Device Management.

classes.name: SnowDeviceManagementClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Snow Device Management service, providing methods to manage Snow devices and tasks.

methods.name: cancelTask
methods.description: Cancels a specified task in Snow Device Management.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task in Snow Device Management.

methods.name: describeDevice
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific device.

methods.name: describeDeviceEc2Instances
methods.description: Describes EC2 instances associated with a device.

methods.name: describeDeviceEc2InstancesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes EC2 instances associated with a device.

methods.name: describeExecution
methods.description: Describes a specific execution of a task.

methods.name: describeTask
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific task.

methods.name: listDeviceResources
methods.description: Lists resources associated with a device.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists all devices managed within Snow Device Management.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
